title: Dutch Defense: Staunton Gambit
line: White gives a pawn at once to open lines against Black's king.

steps.text: White offers a pawn at once: the Staunton Gambit. White gives a pawn for quick development and open lines.
Bring the knight out. It guards the pawn on e4.

wrong.d7d5: Then White's queen checks on h5 and takes the pawn on d5.

steps.text: Bring the other knight out, to attack White's pawn on d4.

also.g7g6: That is a main line too. This lesson goes on with the knight.

steps.text: The knight is attacked. Jump it to the center.
Step it back to safety, near your king.
Chase the knight with the pawn.
steps.after: The pawns are even, and Black has the two bishops.

summary: Take the pawn, guard it with the knight, and keep the diagonal to your king closed. Black gets the two bishops.
